examples.chinese: 他今天很開心。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīntiān hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: He is very happy today.

examples.chinese: 今天我去朋友家玩得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ qù péngyǒu jiā wán de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: I had fun at my friend’s place today.

examples.chinese: 他唱歌唱得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Tā chànggē chàng de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: He enjoys singing very much.

examples.chinese: 我昨天跟朋友說了很多話，我們都很開心。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān gēn péngyou shuō le hěn duō huà, wǒmen dōu hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: Yesterday I said a lot to my friend, and we were both very happy.

examples.chinese: 你們在聊什麼？聊得好開心。
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen zài liáo shénme? Liáo de hǎo kāixīn.
examples.english: What are you chatting about? You're chatting so happily.

examples.chinese: 來台灣以後，每個週末我都有很多活動，覺得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Lái Táiwān yǐhòu, měi ge zhōumò wǒ dōu yǒu hěn duō huódòng, juéde hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: After coming to Taiwan, I have many activities every weekend and feel very happy.

examples.chinese: 這是我第一次來台灣，我覺得好開心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì lái Táiwān, wǒ juéde hǎo kāixīn.
examples.english: This is my first time coming to Taiwan, I feel very happy.

examples.chinese: 他的表演很有意思，我們大家看得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Tā de biǎoyǎn hěn yǒu yìsi, wǒmen dàjiā kàn de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: His performance is very interesting, we all watched it very happily.

examples.chinese: 這張照片裡的人都笑得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhàopiàn lǐ de rén dōu xiào de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: The people in this photo are all smiling very happily.

examples.chinese: A:你怎麼了？看起來很不開心的樣子。 B:唉！工廠發生問題，今天又得加班處理了。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ zěnme le? Kàn qǐlái hěn bù kāixīn de yàngzi. B: Āi! Gōngchǎng fāshēng wèntí, jīntiān yòu děi jiābān chǔlǐ le.
examples.english: A: What's wrong? You look very unhappy. B: Alas! There's a problem at the factory; I have to work overtime again today to deal with it.

examples.chinese: 我昨天晚上做了一個夢，夢到跟我最喜歡的明星一同演戲，開心得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān wǎnshang zuò le yī gè mèng, mèng dào gēn wǒ zuì xǐhuan de míngxīng yītóng yǎnxì, kāixīn de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: Last night I had a dream; I dreamed of acting together with my favorite celebrity, and I was incredibly happy.

examples.chinese: 週末我帶孩子們去鄉下玩，他們餵小羊吃草，拿饅頭給猴子吃，玩得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ dài háizimen qù xiāngxià wán, tāmen wèi xiǎoyáng chī cǎo, ná mántou gěi hóuzi chī, wán de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: On the weekend, I took the children to the countryside to play; they fed the lambs grass and gave steamed buns to the monkeys to eat, and they had a great time.

examples.chinese: 我是金東賢的戲迷，今天終於看到他本人，實在太開心了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shì Jīn Dōngxián de xìmí, jīntiān zhōngyú kàndào tā běnrén, shízài tài kāixīn le.
examples.english: I am a fan of Kim Dong-hyun; today I finally saw him in person, and I am really so happy.

examples.chinese: 每當包太太心情不好的時候，包先生就會說笑話來逗她，讓她開心一點。
examples.pinyin: Měidāng Bāo tàitai xīnqíng bù hǎo de shíhou, Bāo xiānsheng jiù huì shuō xiàohua lái dòu tā, ràng tā kāixīn yìdiǎn.
examples.english: Whenever Mrs. Bao is in a bad mood, Mr. Bao will tell jokes to tease her and make her a little happier.

examples.chinese: 儘管爺爺去世很久了，但每次看到照片，就會回想起他開心陪我玩的樣子。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn yéye qùshì hěn jiǔ le, dàn měi cì kàn dào zhàopiàn, jiù huì huíxiǎng qǐ tā kāixīn péi wǒ wán de yàngzi.
examples.english: Even though Grandpa passed away a long time ago, every time I see a photo, I recall how he happily played with me.

examples.chinese: 很多年輕男生愛在書店看汽車雜誌，汽車很貴，他們不一定可以買新車，可是都看得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō niánqīng nánshēng ài zài shūdiàn kàn qìchē zázhì, qìchē hěn guì, tāmen bù yídìng kěyǐ mǎi xīn chē, kěshì dōu kàn de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: Many young men like to read car magazines at bookstores. Cars are expensive and they don’t usually have the money to buy new ones; however, they are very happy just by reading those magazines.

items.wordHook: 開(open) + 心(heart) → an open heart means happy.

examples.chinese: 我跟朋友聊天，聊得很愉快。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn péngyou liáotiān, liáo de hěn yúkuài.
examples.english: I chatted with friends and enjoyed it very much.

examples.chinese:
路旁有很多小白花，我常常摘一些放在書桌上，看著看著心情就愉快了。
進辦公室前，別忘了摘下帽子，這是一種禮貌。
examples.pinyin:
Lù páng yǒu hěn duō xiǎo bái huā, wǒ chángcháng zhāi yīxiē fàng zài shūzhuō shàng, kàn zhe kàn zhe xīnqíng jiù yúkuài le.
Jìn bàngōngshì qián, bié wàng le zhāi xià màozi, zhè shì yī zhǒng lǐmào.
examples.english:
There are many small white flowers by the roadside; I often pick some and put them on my desk, and as I look at them, my mood becomes cheerful.
Before entering the office, don't forget to take off your hat; this is a kind of courtesy.

examples.chinese: 張先生的個性很活潑、說話很幽默，跟他聊天總是很愉快。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng de gèxìng hěn huópō, shuōhuà hěn yōumò, gēn tā liáotiān zǒngshì hěn yúkuài.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang's personality is very lively and his speech is very humorous; chatting with him is always very pleasant.

examples.chinese: 在所有的同事中，我覺得小周最好相處了。他的性格開朗、說話幽默，還常主動幫忙，跟他相處起來很愉快、很自在。
examples.pinyin: Zài suǒyǒu de tóngshì zhōng, wǒ juéde Xiǎo Zhōu zuì hǎo xiāngchǔ le. Tā de xìnggé kāilǎng, shuōhuà yōumò, hái cháng zhǔdòng bāngmáng, gēn tā xiāngchǔ qǐlái hěn yúkuài, hěn zìzài.
examples.english: Among all my colleagues, I think Xiao Zhou is the easiest to get along with. He has a cheerful personality, speaks humorously, and often offers help proactively; getting along with him is very pleasant and relaxed.

examples.chinese: 到別人家做客時不能太隨便，以免發生不愉快的事。
examples.pinyin: Dào biérén jiā zuòkè shí bù néng tài suíbiàn, yǐmiǎn fāshēng bù yúkuài de shì.
examples.english: When you are a guest at someone else’s home, you must not be too casual, so as to avoid unpleasant things happening.

examples.chinese: 電視臺播出的娛樂節目多半是唱歌跳舞的表演，能讓觀眾心情愉快。
examples.pinyin: Diànshìtái bōchū de yúlè jiémù duōbàn shì chànggē tiàowǔ de biǎoyǎn, néng ràng guānzhòng xīnqíng yúkuài.
examples.english: Most of the entertainment programs broadcast by TV stations are singing and dancing performances, which can make the audience feel happy.

examples.chinese: 你不需要事事都跟別人做比較，自己過得輕鬆愉快就好。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bù xūyào shìshì dōu gēn biérén zuò bǐjiào, zìjǐ guò de qīngsōng yúkuài jiù hǎo.
examples.english: You don't need to compare yourself with others in everything; it's fine as long as you live relaxed and happy.

examples.chinese: 當別人遇到不愉快的事時，應該避免說些刺激他的話。
examples.pinyin: Dāng biérén yùdào bù yúkuài de shì shí, yīnggāi bìmiǎn shuō xiē cìjī tā de huà.
examples.english: When others encounter unpleasant things, one should avoid saying things that irritate them.

examples.chinese: 學校的畢業典禮辦得很精彩，讓我們度過了愉快的一天。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào de bìyè diǎnlǐ bàn de hěn jīngcǎi, ràng wǒmen dùguò le yúkuài de yī tiān.
examples.english: The school's graduation ceremony was held wonderfully, allowing us to spend a happy day.

examples.chinese:
你們之間的誤會越來越深，要是不面對面說清楚，恐怕連朋友都當不成了。
下課以後，老師幫我一對一補習數學，希望我的期末考會及格。
昨天的歐洲足球賽，法國對義大利的比賽真是太刺激了。
examples.pinyin:
Nǐmen zhījiān de wùhuì yuè lái yuè shēn, yàobùshì miànduìmiàn shuō qīngchǔ, kǒngpà lián péngyǒu dōu dāng bù chéng le.
Xiàkè yǐhòu, lǎoshī bāng wǒ yī duì yī bǔxí shùxué, xīwàng wǒ de qīmòkǎo huì jígé.
Zuótiān de Ōuzhōu zúqiúsài, Fǎguó duì Yìdàlì de bǐsài zhēn shì tài cìjī le.
examples.english:
The misunderstanding between you two is getting deeper and deeper; if you don't talk it out face to face, I'm afraid you won't even be able to remain friends.
After class, the teacher helped me with one-on-one math tutoring, hoping I will pass the final exam.
Yesterday's European football match, France versus Italy, was really too exciting.

examples.chinese: 昨天棒球賽進行到一半時突然下起了大雨，雖然後來雨停了，但因為球場太溼，也無法繼續比賽了。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān bàngqiúsài jìnxíng dào yíbàn shí tūrán xià qǐ le dàyǔ, suīrán hòulái yǔ tíng le, dàn yīnwèi qiúchǎng tài shī, yě wúfǎ jìxù bǐsài le.
examples.english: Yesterday, when the baseball game had proceeded to halfway, it suddenly started raining heavily. Although the rain stopped later, because the field was too wet, the game could not continue.

examples.chinese: 經過多次訓練，他總算贏得這場球賽的冠軍。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò duō cì xùnliàn, tā zǒngsuàn yíngdé zhè chǎng qiúsài de guànjūn.
examples.english: After many training sessions, he finally won the championship of this ball game.

examples.chinese: 這些碗筷、刀叉我都還沒擦乾，不可以給客人用。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē wǎnkuài, dāochā wǒ dōu hái méi cā gān, bù kěyǐ gěi kèrén yòng.
examples.english: I haven't dried these bowls, chopsticks, and cutlery yet; they can't be given to guests to use.

examples.chinese: 昨天洗的衣服乾了沒有？這些碗筷、刀叉我都還沒擦乾，不可以給客人用。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān xǐ de yīfu gān le méiyǒu? Zhèxiē wǎnkuài, dāochā wǒ dōu hái méi cā gān, bù kěyǐ gěi kèrén yòng.
examples.english: Are the clothes washed yesterday dry yet? I haven't dried these bowls, chopsticks, and cutlery yet; they can't be given to guests to use.

examples.chinese: 他把全部的碗筷都擦乾了，可以給客人用了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ quánbù de wǎnkuài dōu cā gān le, kěyǐ gěi kèrén yòng le.
examples.english: He wiped all the bowls and chopsticks dry; they can be used for the guests now.

examples.chinese: 請不要把貼紙貼在教室的桌子上。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bùyào bǎ tiēzhǐ tiē zài jiàoshì de zhuōzi shàng.
examples.english: Please don't stick stickers on the classroom desks.

examples.chinese: 我想要得到便利商店的貼紙，所以花了很多錢買東西。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng yào dédào biànlì shāngdiàn de tiēzhǐ, suǒyǐ huā le hěn duō qián mǎi dōngxi.
examples.english: I wanted to get the convenience store stickers, so I spent a lot of money buying things.

examples.chinese:
張先生常幫太太買菜、洗衣服， 要是比太太早下班，還會把晚餐做好，真體貼。
我同學很體貼父母，經常煮飯、 做家事，幫了父母不少忙。
examples.pinyin:
Zhāng xiānsheng cháng bāng tàitai mǎi cài, xǐ yīfu, yàoshi bǐ tàitai zǎo xiàbān, hái huì bǎ wǎncān zuò hǎo, zhēn tǐtiē.
Wǒ tóngxué hěn tǐtiē fùmǔ, jīngcháng zhǔfàn, zuò jiāshì, bāng le fùmǔ bùshǎo máng.
examples.english:
Mr. Zhang often helps his wife buy groceries and wash clothes; if he gets off work earlier than his wife, he also makes dinner—he is truly considerate.
My classmate is very considerate of his parents; he often cooks and does housework, helping his parents a lot.

examples.chinese:
包小姐的眼光很好，一看就知道那件黃色外套的品質最好。
妹妹：我希望將來找個又聰明又有錢 ，而且很體貼我的男朋友。 姊姊：妳的眼光太高了，恐怕找不到。
examples.pinyin:
Bāo xiǎojiě de yǎnguāng hěn hǎo, yí kàn jiù zhīdào nà jiàn huángsè wàitào de pǐnzhí zuì hǎo.
Mèimei: Wǒ xīwàng jiānglái zhǎo ge yòu cōngmíng yòu yǒu qián, érqiě hěn tǐtiē wǒ de nánpéngyou. Jiějie: Nǐ de yǎnguāng tài gāo le, kǒngpà zhǎo bú dào.
examples.english:
Miss Bao has a good eye; she can tell at a glance that the quality of that yellow coat is the best.
Younger sister: I hope to find a boyfriend in the future who is smart, rich, and very considerate of me. Older sister: Your standards are too high; I'm afraid you won't find one.

examples.chinese: 他雖然年紀小，但是對人有禮貌，也很體貼父母，是個乖孩子。
examples.pinyin: Tā suīrán niánjì xiǎo, dànshì duì rén yǒu lǐmào, yě hěn tǐtiē fùmǔ, shì ge guāi háizi.
examples.english: Although he is young, he is polite to people and also very considerate of his parents; he is a well-behaved child.

examples.chinese:
我跟弟弟是雙胞胎，很多人都以為我是他，這樣的誤會我早就習慣了。
A:何小姐只是我的鄰居，不是我的女朋友，大家都誤會了。 B:你對她很體貼，不但常送她上班，還常陪她逛街，大家對你們有誤會也是正常的。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ gēn dìdi shì shuāngbāotāi, hěn duō rén dōu yǐwéi wǒ shì tā, zhèyàng de wùhuì wǒ zǎo jiù xíguàn le.
A: Hé xiǎojiě zhǐshì wǒ de línjū, bùshì wǒ de nǚpéngyǒu, dàjiā dōu wùhuì le. B: Nǐ duì tā hěn tǐtiē, bùdàn cháng sòng tā shàngbān, hái cháng péi tā guàngjiē, dàjiā duì nǐmen yǒu wùhuì yě shì zhèngcháng de.
examples.english:
My younger brother and I are twins; many people think I am him, and I've long been used to this kind of misunderstanding.
A: Miss He is just my neighbor, not my girlfriend; everyone has misunderstood. B: You are very considerate to her; not only do you often take her to work, but you also often accompany her shopping. It's normal for everyone to have a misunderstanding about you two.

examples.chinese:
我們公司打算今年跟美國合作，生產名牌皮包。
除夕那天，大家都忙著打掃、貼春聯，只有弟弟很不合作，什麼事都不做。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒmen gōngsī dǎsuàn jīnnián gēn Měiguó hézuò, shēngchǎn míngpái píbāo.
Chúxī nà tiān, dàjiā dōu mángzhe dǎsǎo, tiē chūnlián, zhǐyǒu dìdi hěn bù hézuò, shénme shì dōu bù zuò.
examples.english:
Our company plans to cooperate with the US this year to produce brand-name leather bags.
On New Year's Eve, everyone was busy cleaning and putting up spring couplets; only my younger brother was very uncooperative and didn't do anything.

examples.chinese: 石經理對員工很兇，回家後卻能表現出溫柔的一面，非常體貼太太。
examples.pinyin: Shí jīnglǐ duì yuángōng hěn xiōng, huíjiā hòu què néng biǎoxiàn chū wēnróu de yí miàn, fēicháng tǐtiē tàitai.
examples.english: Manager Shi is very fierce to employees, but after going home he can show a gentle aspect and is very considerate of his wife.

examples.chinese: 每個民族都有自己獨特的習俗，像華人除夕貼春聯、年夜飯的魚不能吃光就很特別。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge mínzú dōu yǒu zìjǐ dútè de xísú, xiàng Huárén chúxī tiē chūnlián, niányèfàn de yú bù néng chī guāng jiù hěn tèbié.
examples.english: Every ethnic group has its own unique customs. For example, it is very special that Chinese people put up spring couplets on New Year's Eve and that the fish for the New Year's Eve dinner cannot be completely eaten.

examples.chinese: A:我對何小姐是真心的，為什麼她一直不肯接受呢？ B:你應該更關心她、更體貼她，讓她知道你是真心愛她的。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ duì Hé xiǎojiě shì zhēnxīn de, wèishénme tā yìzhí bù kěn jiēshòu ne? B: Nǐ yīnggāi gèng guānxīn tā, gèng tǐtiē tā, ràng tā zhīdào nǐ shì zhēnxīn ài tā de.
examples.english: A: I am sincere toward Miss He; why does she keep refusing to accept me? B: You should care about her more and be more considerate of her, so she knows you truly love her.

examples.chinese: 這條路不平，有民眾貼了海報，請大家走路時要小心，以免受傷。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù bù píng, yǒu mínzhòng tiē le hǎibào, qǐng dàjiā zǒulù shí yào xiǎoxīn, yǐmiǎn shòushāng.
examples.english: This road is uneven, and some people have put up posters asking everyone to be careful when walking, in order to avoid getting hurt.

examples.chinese: 那家餐廳的服務生很貼心，只要客人一上門，立刻提供面紙給客人擦手。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng de fúwùshēng hěn tiēxīn, zhǐyào kèrén yī shàngmén, lìkè tígōng miànzhǐ gěi kèrén cā shǒu.
examples.english: The waiters at that restaurant are very considerate; as soon as customers come in, they immediately provide tissues for them to wipe their hands.

examples.chinese: 公司的布告上貼著超市打折活動的廣告，感覺真的很怪。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de bùgào shàng tiēzhe chāoshì dǎzhé huódòng de guǎnggào, gǎnjué zhēn de hěn guài.
examples.english: The company's notice has an ad for a supermarket discount event posted on it; it feels really strange.

examples.chinese: 老謝溫柔體貼、聰明英俊，符合我結婚對象的條件，因此我答應嫁給他。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo Xiè wēnróu tǐtiē, cōngmíng yīngjùn, fúhé wǒ jiéhūn duìxiàng de tiáojiàn, yīncǐ wǒ dāyìng jià gěi tā.
examples.english: Old Xie is gentle and considerate, smart and handsome, and meets the conditions for my marriage partner; therefore, I agreed to marry him.

examples.chinese: 華人過春節時有個風俗，就是每戶人家都會在門口貼春聯。
examples.pinyin: Huárén guò Chūnjié shí yǒu ge fēngsú, jiùshì měi hù rénjiā dōu huì zài ménkǒu tiē chūnlián.
examples.english: When Chinese people celebrate Spring Festival, there is a custom: every household will paste spring couplets at the door.

items.wordHook: A 貝(sea shell) is pressed onto a wall to 占(occupy) that spot, so it stays stuck there → 貼(stick).

examples.chinese: 小何穿著綠色牛仔褲、紅襯衫，再戴上藍色的帽子，我覺得這些顏色配在一起很醜。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Hé chuānzhe lǜsè niúzǎikù, hóng chènshān, zài dài shàng lánsè de màozi, wǒ juéde zhèxiē yánsè pèi zài yīqǐ hěn chǒu.
examples.english: Xiǎo Hé is wearing green jeans, a red shirt, and then puts on a blue hat; I think these colors paired together are very ugly.

examples.chinese: 根據醫院規定，進入病房後禁止大聲說話。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù yīyuàn guīdìng, jìnrù bìngfáng hòu jìnzhǐ dàshēng shuōhuà.
examples.english: According to hospital regulations, after entering the ward, speaking loudly is prohibited.

examples.chinese: 這個影片介紹了亞洲的飲食文化。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yǐngpiàn jièshào le Yàzhōu de yǐnshí wénhuà.
examples.english: This video introduced Asia's food culture.

examples.chinese: 媽媽替我報名了亞洲鋼琴比賽，她說只要我肯努力，一定會有好成績的。
examples.pinyin: Māma tì wǒ bàomíngle Yàzhōu gāngqín bǐsài, tā shuō zhǐyào wǒ kěn nǔlì, yīdìng huì yǒu hǎo chéngjī de.
examples.english: My mother signed me up for the Asian Piano Competition. She said that as long as I am willing to work hard, I will definitely get good results.

examples.chinese: 這家電腦公司本來只服務亞洲地區的民眾，現在服務範圍已經擴大到歐洲了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diànnǎo gōngsī běnlái zhǐ fúwù Yàzhōu dìqū de mínzhòng, xiànzài fúwù fànwéi yǐjīng kuòdà dào Ōuzhōu le.
examples.english: This computer company originally only served people in the Asian region, but now its service range has already expanded to Europe.

examples.chinese: 這次亞洲文化展，除了樂器表演，還有傳統服裝試穿活動，歡迎各位來參觀。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì Yàzhōu wénhuà zhǎn, chúle yuèqì biǎoyǎn, hái yǒu chuántǒng fúzhuāng shìchuān huódòng, huānyíng gèwèi lái cānguān.
examples.english: This Asian Culture Exhibition, in addition to musical instrument performances, also has traditional clothing try-on activities; everyone is welcome to visit.

examples.chinese: 亞洲地區發生了嚴重的流行病，使人民受到相當大的生活壓力。
examples.pinyin: Yàzhōu dìqū fāshēng le yánzhòng de liúxíngbìng, shǐ rénmín shòudào xiāngdāng dà de shēnghuó yālì.
examples.english: A serious epidemic broke out in the Asian region, causing people to receive considerable life pressure.

examples.chinese: 亞洲地區發生了戰爭，使人民生活上所受的的壓力相當大。
examples.pinyin: Yàzhōu dìqū fāshēng le zhànzhēng, shǐ rénmín shēnghuó shàng suǒ shòu de yālì xiāngdāng dà.
examples.english: War broke out in the Asian region, causing the pressure that people received in life to be considerable.

examples.chinese: 他對亞洲文化相當有興趣，計畫將來走遍全亞洲。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì Yàzhōu wénhuà xiāngdāng yǒu xìngqù, jìhuà jiānglái zǒu biàn quán Yàzhōu.
examples.english: He is quite interested in Asian culture and plans to travel all over Asia in the future.

examples.chinese: 這家國際企業因商品銷售情況不理想，決定退出亞洲市場。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā guójì qǐyè yīn shāngpǐn xiāoshòu qíngkuàng bù lǐxiǎng, juédìng tuìchū Yàzhōu shìchǎng.
examples.english: This international enterprise, because product sales were not ideal, decided to withdraw from the Asian market.

examples.chinese: 這裡的交通有很大的改變，比以前方便多了。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de jiāotōng yǒu hěn dà de gǎibiàn, bǐ yǐqián fāngbiàn duō le.
examples.english: The transportation here has undergone a big change; it's much more convenient than before.

examples.chinese:
沒有人知道自己的命能有多長， 所以每天都應該好好過日子。
不少人相信人的命是被決定的， 誰都改變不了。
examples.pinyin:
Méiyǒu rén zhīdào zìjǐ de mìng néng yǒu duō cháng, suǒyǐ měi tiān dōu yīnggāi hǎohǎo guò rìzi.
Bùshǎo rén xiāngxìn rén de mìng shì bèi juédìng de, shéi dōu gǎibiàn bù liǎo.
examples.english:
No one knows how long their own life can be, so every day one should live life well.
Many people believe that a person's fate is decided, and no one can change it.

examples.chinese:
氣象預報人員確定明天颱風會來，我們最好去超市買一些泡麵、雞蛋。
老闆要我照確定的日期去南部出差，如果有什麼改變，他會早點兒通知我。
examples.pinyin:
Qìxiàng yùbào rényuán quèdìng míngtiān táifēng huì lái, wǒmen zuìhǎo qù chāoshì mǎi yìxiē pàomiàn, jīdàn.
Lǎobǎn yào wǒ zhào quèdìng de rìqī qù nánbù chūchāi, rúguǒ yǒu shénme gǎibiàn, tā huì zǎodiǎnr tōngzhī wǒ.
examples.english:
The weather forecasters are sure that the typhoon will come tomorrow; we'd better go to the supermarket to buy some instant noodles and eggs.
The boss wants me to go on a business trip to the south according to the confirmed date; if there are any changes, he will notify me earlier.

examples.chinese: 「了」這個詞的用法可以代表事情完成或情況改變。
examples.pinyin: 「le」 zhège cí de yòngfǎ kěyǐ dàibiǎo shìqíng wánchéng huò qíngkuàng gǎibiàn.
examples.english: The usage of the word 'le' can represent the completion of an action or a change in situation.

examples.chinese: 對華人來說，把書念好才有美好的未來，這個傳統觀念在臺灣已經慢慢改變了。
examples.pinyin: Duì Huárén lái shuō, bǎ shū niàn hǎo cái yǒu měihǎo de wèilái, zhège chuántǒng guānniàn zài Táiwān yǐjīng mànman gǎibiàn le.
examples.english: For Chinese people, only by studying well can one have a beautiful future; this traditional concept has already gradually changed in Taiwan.

examples.chinese:
時代進步了，女人在家庭和社會中的地位也跟著提高了。
在古代中國，男人不應該進廚房的傳統觀念，也因為時代的改變而不同。
examples.pinyin:
Shídài jìnbù le, nǚrén zài jiātíng hé shèhuì zhōng de dìwèi yě gēnzhe tígāo le.
Zài gǔdài Zhōngguó, nánrén bù yīnggāi jìn chúfáng de chuántǒng guānniàn, yě yīnwèi shídài de gǎibiàn ér bùtóng.
examples.english:
Times have progressed, and women's status in the family and society has risen accordingly.
In ancient China, the traditional concept that men should not enter the kitchen has also changed with the times.

examples.chinese:
科學家發明了電燈，改變了人類的生活方式，也大大提高了生活品質。
網路是很偉大的發明，就算不出門，也能讓人們得到全球各地的訊息。
examples.pinyin:
Kēxuéjiā fāmíng le diàndēng, gǎibiàn le rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì, yě dàdà tígāo le shēnghuó pǐnzhí.
Wǎnglù shì hěn wěidà de fāmíng, jiùsuàn bù chūmén, yě néng ràng rénmen dédào quánqiú gèdì de xùnxí.
examples.english:
Scientists invented the electric light, which changed the lifestyle of mankind and also greatly improved the quality of life.
The Internet is a great invention; even without going out, it can let people get information from all over the world.

examples.chinese: 一個人的想法會隨著身分、角色的不同而改變。
examples.pinyin: Yī ge rén de xiǎngfǎ huì suízhe shēnfèn, juésè de bùtóng ér gǎibiàn.
examples.english: A person's way of thinking will change along with differences in identity and role.

examples.chinese: 每個時代都有自己的價值標準，社會習俗及生活規矩也常隨著時代改變。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge shídài dōu yǒu zìjǐ de jiàzhí biāozhǔn, shèhuì xísú jí shēnghuó guījǔ yě cháng suízhe shídài gǎibiàn.
examples.english: Every era has its own value standards, and social customs and life rules also often change with the times.

examples.chinese: 人類活動產生許多垃圾，不但汙染了環境，更改變了全球氣候。
examples.pinyin: Rénlèi huódòng chǎnshēng xǔduō lājī, bùdàn wūrǎn le huánjìng, gèng gǎibiàn le quánqiú qìhòu.
examples.english: Human activities produce a lot of garbage, which not only polluted the environment but also changed the global climate.

examples.chinese: 今年下雪的時間提早了，氣候改變或許是最主要的原因。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián xià xuě de shíjiān tízǎo le, qìhòu gǎibiàn huòxǔ shì zuì zhǔyào de yuányīn.
examples.english: This year the time of snowfall came earlier than planned; climate change is perhaps the main reason.

examples.chinese: 自從他改變飲食習慣以後，就變得既健康又有活力。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng tā gǎibiàn yǐnshí xíguàn yǐhòu, jiù biàn de jì jiànkāng yòu yǒu huólì.
examples.english: Ever since he changed his eating habits, he has become both healthy and full of vitality.

examples.chinese: 我們無法控制別人的行為，卻能夠改變自己的想法。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen wúfǎ kòngzhì biérén de xíngwéi, què nénggòu gǎibiàn zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.english: We cannot control other people's behavior, but we can change our own thoughts.

examples.chinese: 學校的布告欄總是隨著季節改變而有不同的設計。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào de bùgàolán zǒngshì suízhe jìjié gǎibiàn ér yǒu bùtóng de shèjì.
examples.english: The school's bulletin board always has different designs as the seasons change.

examples.chinese: 有些女性懷孕時飲食習慣會有極大的改變，醫生說這是正常現象。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē nǚxìng huáiyùn shí yǐnshí xíguàn huì yǒu jídà de gǎibiàn, yīshēng shuō zhè shì zhèngcháng xiànxiàng.
examples.english: Some women experience great changes in their eating habits when they become pregnant; doctors say this is a normal phenomenon.

examples.chinese: 教育是國家的根本，能改變國家的未來。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoyù shì guójiā de gēnběn, néng gǎibiàn guójiā de wèilái.
examples.english: Education is the foundation of a country; it can change the country's future.

examples.chinese: 有時改變原來旅行的安排，可能會帶來不同的樂趣。
examples.pinyin: Yǒushí gǎibiàn yuánlái lǚxíng de ānpái, kěnéng huì dàilái bùtóng de lèqù.
examples.english: Sometimes changing the original travel arrangements may bring different pleasures.

examples.chinese: 李先生經常咳嗽，可是他完全不在意。直到今天咳得說不出話來了，才肯去看醫生。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiānshēng jīngcháng késòu, kěshì tā wánquán bù zàiyì. Zhídào jīntiān ké de shuō bù chū huà lái le, cái kěn qù kàn yīshēng.
examples.english: Mr. Li often coughs, but he doesn't care at all. It was not until today, when he coughed so much that he couldn't speak, that he was willing to go see a doctor.

examples.chinese: 這條鐵路從北部一直到南部，一共三百公里。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo tiělù cóng běibù yīzhí dào nánbù, yīgòng sānbǎi gōnglǐ.
examples.english: This railway goes from the north all the way to the south, a total of 300 kilometers.

examples.chinese: 他把所有的錢都給了女朋友，直到女朋友被警察抓了，才知道自己被騙。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ suǒyǒu de qián dōu gěi le nǚpéngyǒu, zhídào nǚpéngyǒu bèi jǐngchá zhuā le, cái zhīdào zìjǐ bèi piàn.
examples.english: He gave all his money to his girlfriend, and only when his girlfriend was caught by the police did he realize he had been cheated.

examples.chinese: 他透過網路認識了一位網友，直到結婚前，他們才見過對方三次。
examples.pinyin: Tā tòuguò wǎnglù rènshi le yī wèi wǎngyǒu, zhídào jiéhūn qián, tāmen cái jiàn guò duìfāng sān cì.
examples.english: He met an online friend through the Internet, and they had only seen each other three times before they got married.

items.wordHook: Combining 直(straight) and 到(go to): 直到 means until.

examples.chinese: 簡老闆因為生意的關係，經常接觸越南人，相當了解兩國之間工作習慣的差異。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎn lǎobǎn yīnwèi shēngyì de guānxì, jīngcháng jiēchù Yuènánrén, xiāngdāng liǎojiě liǎng guó zhījiān gōngzuò xíguàn de chāyì.
examples.english: Boss Jian, because of business, frequently contacts Vietnamese people and quite understands the differences in working habits between the two countries.

examples.chinese: 章小姐接觸電影表演工作不久，雖然還是新人，對表演技巧倒是掌握得挺好的。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiǎojiě jiēchù diànyǐng biǎoyǎn gōngzuò bùjiǔ, suīrán hái shì xīnrén, duì biǎoyǎn jìqiǎo dàoshì zhǎngwò de tǐng hǎo de.
examples.english: Miss Zhang has not been involved in film acting for long; although she is still a newcomer, she has actually mastered acting techniques quite well.

examples.chinese: 接觸陌生的事情及環境時，往往令人有點兒不安，這樣的感覺是很自然的。
examples.pinyin: Jiēchù mòshēng de shìqíng jí huánjìng shí, wǎngwǎng lìng rén yǒudiǎnr bù'ān, zhèyàng de gǎnjué shì hěn zìrán de.
examples.english: When coming into contact with unfamiliar things and environments, people often feel a bit uneasy; this feeling is very natural.

examples.chinese: 那個店員的工作態度很隨便，常弄錯商品的價格，還找錯錢， 真是太誇張了！
examples.pinyin: Nàge diànyuán de gōngzuò tàidù hěn suíbiàn, cháng nòngcuò shāngpǐn de jiàgé, hái zhǎo cuò qián, zhēn shì tài kuāzhāng le!
examples.english: That clerk's work attitude is very careless; he often gets the product prices wrong and also gives the wrong change—that's really too outrageous!

examples.chinese: 有一些網路上的資料或影片是被保護的，不能隨便下載。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yīxiē wǎnglù shàng de zīliào huò yǐngpiàn shì bèi bǎohù de, bùnéng suíbiàn xiàzài.
examples.english: Some materials or videos on the internet are protected and cannot be downloaded casually.

examples.chinese: 到別人家做客時不能太隨便，以免發生不愉快的事。
examples.pinyin: Dào biérén jiā zuòkè shí bù néng tài suíbiàn, yǐmiǎn fāshēng bù yúkuài de shì.
examples.english: When you are a guest at someone else’s home, you must not be too casual, so as to avoid unpleasant things happening.

examples.chinese: 要是你對文藝領域不了解，最好不要隨便批評別人的作品。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ duì wényì lǐngyù bù liǎojiě, zuìhǎo bùyào suíbiàn pīpíng biérén de zuòpǐn.
examples.english: If you don't understand the field of literature and art, you'd better not casually criticize others' works.

examples.chinese: 在意外的發生原因沒查清楚之前，別隨便冤枉任何人。
examples.pinyin: Zài yìwài de fāshēng yuányīn méi chá qīngchu zhīqián, bié suíbiàn yuānwang rènhé rén.
examples.english: Before the cause of the accident is clearly investigated, don't wrongly accuse anyone casually.

examples.chinese:
孩子是父母最珍貴的寶貝，父母對他們的愛也是最真實的。
小文房內的櫃子裡擺了很多寶貝，都是他上山下海帶回來的紀念品。
examples.pinyin:
Háizi shì fùmǔ zuì zhēnguì de bǎobèi, fùmǔ duì tāmen de ài yě shì zuì zhēnshí de.
Xiǎo Wén fángnèi de guìzi lǐ bǎi le hěn duō bǎobèi, dōu shì tā shàngshān xiàhǎi dài huílái de jìniànpǐn.
examples.english:
Children are their parents' most precious treasures, and parents' love for them is also the most genuine.
In the cabinet in Little Wen's room, there are many treasures displayed, all souvenirs he brought back from climbing mountains and exploring the seas.

examples.chinese: 孩子是父母最親愛的寶貝，父母對他們的愛是沒辦法用文字來形容的。
examples.pinyin: Háizi shì fùmǔ zuì qīn'ài de bǎobèi, fùmǔ duì tāmen de ài shì méi bànfǎ yòng wénzì lái xíngróng de.
examples.english: Children are their parents' most beloved treasures; parents' love for them cannot be described in words.

examples.chinese: 這幾年由於市長積極實行交通建設計畫，使當地交通情況明顯改善了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ nián yóuyú shìzhǎng jījí shíxíng jiāotōng jiànshè jìhuà, shǐ dāngdì jiāotōng qíngkuàng míngxiǎn gǎishàn le.
examples.english: In recent years, because the mayor actively implemented a transportation construction plan, the local traffic situation has obviously improved.

examples.chinese: 地球氣溫越來越高，世界各地氣候的變化也越來越明顯。
examples.pinyin: Dìqiú qìwēn yuè lái yuè gāo, shìjiè gèdì qìhòu de biànhuà yě yuè lái yuè míngxiǎn.
examples.english: The Earth’s temperature is getting higher and higher, and climate changes around the world are also becoming more and more obvious.

examples.chinese: 有些病頭幾個月的症狀不明顯，得做進一步的檢查才能確定。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē bìng tóu jǐ gè yuè de zhèngzhuàng bù míngxiǎn, děi zuò jìnyībù de jiǎnchá cái néng quèdìng.
examples.english: For some diseases, the symptoms in the first few months are not obvious; further examination is needed to confirm.

examples.chinese: 他把這塊長方形蛋糕分成兩塊三角形的。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ zhè kuài chángfāngxíng dàngāo fēn chéng liǎng kuài sānjiǎoxíng de.
examples.english: He divided this rectangular cake into two triangular pieces.

examples.chinese: 太太：要是你閒著沒事，就幫我泡一壺熱茶吧。先生：我哪裡閒？我馬上要開雲端會議了，可是忙得很呢！
examples.pinyin: Tàitai: Yàoshi nǐ xián zhe méishì, jiù bāng wǒ pào yī hú rè chá ba. Xiānsheng: Wǒ nǎlǐ xián? Wǒ mǎshàng yào kāi yúnduān huìyì le, kěshì máng de hěn ne!
examples.english: Wife: If you're idle with nothing to do, then help me brew a pot of hot tea. Husband: How am I idle? I'm about to start a cloud meeting; I'm really busy!

examples.chinese: 學校蓋了一棟活動中心，學生又多了一個交流、休閒的好場所了。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào gài le yī dòng huódòng zhōngxīn, xuéshēng yòu duō le yī gè jiāoliú, xiūxián de hǎo chǎngsuǒ le.
examples.english: The school has built an activity center; the students now have one more good place for interaction and leisure.

examples.chinese: 我覺得減少工作，增加有意義的休閒活動，這樣的生活比較充實。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde jiǎnshǎo gōngzuò, zēngjiā yǒu yìyì de xiūxián huódòng, zhèyàng de shēnghuó bǐjiào chōngshí.
examples.english: I think reducing work and increasing meaningful leisure activities—this kind of life is more fulfilling.

examples.chinese: 當人們生活水準提高，開始重視生活品質時，休閒活動也就跟著多了起來。
examples.pinyin: Dāng rénmen shēnghuó shuǐzhǔn tígāo, kāishǐ zhòngshì shēnghuó pǐnzhí shí, xiūxián huódòng yě jiù gēnzhe duō le qǐlái.
examples.english: When people's standard of living rises and they begin to value quality of life, leisure activities then increase accordingly.

examples.chinese: 市場為了改善兒童和青少年的生活品質，而增加了球場、游泳池等休閒場所。
examples.pinyin: Shìchǎng wèile gǎishàn értóng hé qīngshàonián de shēnghuó pǐnzhí, ér zēngjiā le qiúchǎng, yóuyǒngchí děng xiūxián chǎngsuǒ.
examples.english: In order to improve the quality of life for children and teenagers, the market added leisure places such as ball courts and swimming pools.

examples.chinese:
我最喜歡的休閒活動是爬山和露營。
為了身體和心理的健康，就算再忙，假日也應該休閒一下。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ zuì xǐhuān de xiūxián huódòng shì páshān hé lùyíng.
Wèile shēntǐ hé xīnlǐ de jiànkāng, jiùsuàn zài máng, jiàrì yě yīnggāi xiūxián yīxià.
examples.english:
My favorite leisure activities are mountain climbing and camping.
For the sake of physical and mental health, even if you're busy, you should still take some leisure time on holidays.

examples.chinese: 對我來說，閱讀醫學系列的小說是一個很好的休閒活動。
examples.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, yuèdú yīxué xìliè de xiǎoshuō shì yī gè hěn hǎo de xiūxián huódòng.
examples.english: For me, reading medical series novels is a very good leisure activity.

examples.chinese: 我小時候最棒的休閒活動是到爺爺的菜園挖地種菜。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎoshíhou zuì bàng de xiūxián huódòng shì dào yéye de càiyuán wā dì zhòng cài.
examples.english: When I was a child, the best leisure activity was going to my grandfather's vegetable garden to dig the soil and plant vegetables.

examples.chinese: 我跟朋友手機的式樣很接近，難怪我們常常拿錯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn péngyǒu shǒujī de shìyàng hěn jiējìn, nánguài wǒmen chángcháng ná cuò.
examples.english: My friend's and my cell phones are very similar in style; no wonder we often take the wrong one.

items.wordHook: Engaged in 作(make) as one of 者(those who): 作者 means author.
The left figure leans back to back with a 匕(spoon) twin → facing away: 北(north).
A sparkling 丶(dot) of starlight beside the full 月(moon) makes the clear night sky vivid and 朗(bright).
a 氵(water) stream rests at 先(first) light → time to 洗(wash).
Combining 至(reach) and 於(at): 至於 means as to.
